title: Package 171-R7 Coupled Driver Implementation and Safeguards Verification
finding: Package 171-R7 coupled driver (driver_package171_r7_c6_coupled_pdas.py) successfully implemented and verified offline across 22 unit regression tests (100% pass rate).
